author: SegmentLinking
body:
#### PR description:

As per title, the PR aims to add the workflows to test the HLT-like tracking baseline for offline reconstruction with the addition of `.714 `and `.715 ``lstmkFitOnCPUAllIters/lstmkFitOnGPUAllIters ` offline workflows for both CPU and GPU: full (non-tracking-only) RECO with legacy pixel seeding -> LST -> mkFit building -> CKF fit swapped in for initialStep+highPtTripletStep, but without restricting the rest of the iterative tracking: unlike the existing Iters01TrackingOnly variants, this keeps PAT/MiniAOD and electron seeding intact since all standard tracking iterations, e.g. detachedQuadStep, still run. 

This addresses the plan discussed during Phase-2 Software days in [tracking POG presentation](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1704277/#45-tracking-pog).

title: Add offline LST+mkFit (all iterations) Phase-2 RECO workflows
